sentence: This project studies how structures that unfold from compact shapes into 3D shapes change shape under external loads.
This project designs a network that stays secure and keeps working for disaster response when much of the infrastructure is lost.
This project studies how polymer additives help perovskite materials repair defects and cracks, using computer modeling, machine learning and experiments.
This project builds a large database of phonon properties of materials, plus web tools to search, compare and view them.
This project builds gene sequencing tools to tell who the parents are and compares mating behavior across three salamander species.
This project measures the mechanical forces inside living cells and tests whether changes in them affect how the cells produce and secrete proteins.
This project studies problems in statistics and its applications, including dimensionality reduction, random matrices and extreme value theory.
This project studies how healthy plants, soils and microbiomes support sustainable agricultural practices and food security.
This project carries out research in nanoscience and nanotechnology across chemistry, biology, medicine, physics and several engineering fields.
This project tries to find out how hibernating squirrels feel almost no hunger and survive for months without food.
This project builds molecular devices with tunnel junctions that can switch states and respond to light, and studies how charge moves through them.
This project builds high school lessons that teach microelectronics by adding sensors and output devices to a robotics kit.
This project develops and tests tools for teaching immunology in college biology courses.
This project tests whether arrays of tiny lights can brightly light several particles trapped by light to make floating images in the air.
This project builds a way for robots to plan and carry out assembly work from engineering documentation, using AI models that read images and text.
This project studies how rice cultivation practices and climate affect where and when arsenic is released from rice paddy soils and taken up by rice.
This project uses theory to study fundamental particles, dark matter and how the quantum nature of gravity leaves imprints in observable phenomena.
This project builds software so that applications using cameras and other sensors can run on Function-as-a-Service across geo-distributed edge computers.
This project studies how heat moves from gold nanoparticles into the surrounding liquid, so that nanoparticle temperature can be controlled more precisely.
